source.title: Call for Applicants - WAC Leader (August 2020)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Advisory Council (WAC) Leader**, as Daniel Sheppard is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Daniel for the work he has done leading the Council.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Good knowledge of the WCA structure
* A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **September 26th, 2020, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAC can be found in [WCA Motion 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.1 of [WCA Motion 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 顾问理事会负责人招募（2020 年 8 月）
translation.content:
Daniel Sheppard 将卸任 **WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）负责人**，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Daniel 在任期间带领理事会所做的工作。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 5 小时处理理事会工作，并具备以下条件：

* 较强的领导能力
* 出色的沟通能力
* 熟悉 WCA 的组织结构
* 与 WCA 社区有密切联系

申请时间为即日起至 **2020 年 9 月 26 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者请将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
* 担任 WAC 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WAC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)第 4.1 节投票选出并公布新任负责人。

感谢各位申请和支持。
